title: JPRX: a knowledge graph of Japanese robotic construction processes (anonymised release)
description: An explorable, anonymised release of the JPRX knowledge graph of Japanese robotic-construction and digital-fabrication processes: enablers of the Ng et al. (2022) DfDFAB ontology, a census of robotic processes, deep-coded polar cases, literature-cited dependencies between enablers with their evidence grades, and co-occurrence derived from the cases. The archive contains the graph in RDF/Turtle and the Process Atlas, a self-contained web viewer that runs from the archive without a server. Company and robot identities are removed; firms appear as stable pseudonyms so that co-development structure stays analysable. Categorical attributes are released unchanged, so individual well-known processes may remain recognisable.
